name: Excellent Cadavers
storyline:
"They got it wrong you see, it's not like in the movies. To be born into this kind of life you have to be able to look someone in the eye and shoot without hesitating."

"Can you do that, Luce?"

Born into a life of privilege, you’ve always had everything you could have ever possibly needed. A perfect life, kept away from the violence inherent within the family business. That is, you were.

When everything crumbles around you, what will you do? Get revenge or justice? Honor your last name or betray it? Fall in love with who you shouldn’t or sleep your way through your emotional turmoil?
